title: The Edgeware Community Podcast
body:
# The Edgeware Community Podcast
 
**TLDR: Discussion to create the world's first community (DAO) funded podcast.**
 
## Who am I?
My name is Anthony Bertolino (@[idecentralized)](https://twitter.com/iDecentralized) and have been involved in the crypto ecosystem since early 2017. 

On the professional side, working within the Crypto IRA industry, where I currently am the Director of Brand at [iTrustCapital ](https://itrustcapital.com)- the world’s largest Crypto IRA. 

On the hobby side, I have been an active investor + user since early 2017. I claimed an ENS within the first week of it being live, participated in the EDG lockdrop distribution and have a DegenScore of over 900.

I wrote a few key (and semi-viral) articles that helped contribute to the Ethereum narrative during the depths of the bear market:
[Ethereum: The Anti-Fragile Hydra](https://abertolino.medium.com/ethereum-history-an-anti-fragile-hydra-8aa56874f394)
[Ethereum and the Gartner Hype Cycle](https://abertolino.medium.com/ethereum-and-the-gartner-hype-cycle-706c022d1ec4)
[Global Debt, Ethereum and a New Open Financial System](https://abertolino.medium.com/global-debt-ethereum-and-a-new-open-financial-system-30f1085a2fd)
[Google, Internet Stocks and Ethereum](https://abertolino.medium.com/google-internet-stocks-and-ethereum-d8acd2b7e55a)

I also ran the [Ethereum Entrepreneur](https://twitter.com/EthereumPod) podcast for a few episodes, but after discussions with friends like David Hoffman, Anthony Sassano and others - I decided there were already enough Ethereum podcasts with significant signal.

## My angle:
I believe that the fair distribution of Edgeware makes it the go-to EVM compatible substrate layer 1. 

But in order for Edgeware to achieve maximum success, it should be Ethereum aligned. This alignment will allow certain projects that are “Ethereum first” to successfully migrate over to Edgeware when they want to get exposure to the Polkadot/Substrate ecosystem.
